mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which depresses corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (above 2% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns as the economy expands and corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth exceeds 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (above 1600 thousand units) indicates robust consumer demand for housing, which supports broader economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds 1600 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% annually indicates accelerating price pressures, which typically triggers a Fed response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong job growth (above 100k new jobs) and a declining unemployment rate (below 4.5%) signal an overheating labor market, which increases the probability of Fed rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 100k and UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (above 3% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns as the economy expands and corporate earnings rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth (annualized) exceeds 3%.
